notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.61

• No more 'allow DuckOS to…' questions: modifying system settings, deleting pictures in Photos, all-files access and the rest are allowed from the start, as a phone's own apps are.
• Shorter, crisper lock and unlock sounds (heard from the next restart).
• The Now Bar (a running timer, charging) is on the lock screen now, not on the home after unlocking.
• DuckAntivirus is part of Settings › Privacy & Security now, not an app of its own.
• DuckCloud: 'Upgrade storage' is gone; when your space is almost full, one button offers DuckCloud+ — with a preview purchase for now (nothing is charged).
• Quick Settings' brightness works without being sent to a settings screen.
